calendar_relation_evidence.interpretation: The externally specified gross Monday mean exceeded other weekdays in both windows, but this descriptive relation did not survive the full fee, adverse-slippage, opportunity-cost, drawdown, Calmar, annual-breadth and concentration contract.

passed_evidence: The exact sealed 52,608-row H1 corpus, source bindings, UTC day inventory, calendar counts and two byte-identical executions passed all integrity gates.

The gross Monday open-to-open mean exceeded the pooled non-Monday mean in both Design and Validation, so the literature direction replicated descriptively without selecting a weekday from repository outcomes.
Normal-cost aggregate returns were positive in both windows, all 313 Monday episodes completed at exactly twenty-four hours, terminal inventory was zero and Validation episode concentration passed.
These partial facts do not override the fifteen failed economic, stress, path-risk, opportunity-cost, annual-breadth and concentration gates.
material_learning: A stable positive gross weekday mean is not a viable strategy by itself. Weekly two-sided friction turned the Monday-only policy negative under the frozen doubled-cost scenario in both windows, while the normal policy captured only 7.09 percent of Design and 4.34 percent of Validation buy-and-hold return. Validation drawdown remained 26.46 percent versus 32.28 percent for buy-and-hold and Calmar was 0.76 versus 14.40. Returns were positive in only three of six normal years and two of six stress years, including a negative 2023, so the anomaly lacked transferable risk-adjusted breadth.
scientific_claim: The exact externally specified UTC Monday 00:00 to Tuesday 00:00 full-capital BTC-or-zero-yield-cash policy replicated a higher gross Monday mean in 2019-2022 and 2023-2024 but failed frozen cost-stress, drawdown, upside-capture, Calmar, annual-breadth and top-year concentration gates. It is not a candidate and the exact family is permanently closed.
